headline: Kyrgyzstan wants to require QR-code marking of halal products
summary: Kyrgyzstan is proposing mandatory QR-code labelling of halal products and state registries of halal industry participants. The proposal would apply to food producers in the sector.
why: Mandatory product labelling and certification rules raise compliance costs for food producers and shape access to halal export markets.
original_headline: В Кыргызстане халал-продукцию хотят обязать маркировать QR-кодами
